# Rollouts go wrong at handoffs

The [[objects/projects/acme-rollout|Acme Rollout]] depends on [[objects/companies/northwind-supply|Northwind Supply]] delivering to [[objects/companies/acme|Acme]] on time. [[objects/people/nick-alvarez|Nick Alvarez]] and [[objects/people/sam-rivera|Sam Rivera]] each own one side. See also [[objects/concepts/handoff-tax]].
